content:
**Wavy Willard** is a type of fish in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update. 

A rare fish, this local legend can be caught with Bait - Common, Bait - Improved and Bait - Superb. When eaten, it restores a total of 20 Hit Points over 25 seconds. It can alternatively be sold, displayed on a Curved Fish Display or Fish Display Plaque, or cooked into Fish Bits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wavy Willard (1) | | **Built or Scrapped:** | | Fish Bits (25) | 

Can only be caught around Wavy Willard's Water Park in the Toxic Valley.
